summary: Deduplicate exact repeated evidence inside one project-question source scope before applying model-context limits.
decision_refs: The user requested continued CIRP speed and accuracy improvements for file-grounded project questions
An offline reproduction proved that eight identical fragments from one Specification document and scope occupied all eight context slots
Exact scope-local deduplication reduces prompt noise without fuzzy matching or removing independent provenance
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency improvements to the existing Trunk Tools-style file-grounded question flow.
known_limitations: Deduplication is exact and local to one document, source family and semantic locator scope; it does not detect paraphrases or near-duplicates.
A physical Page difference alone does not preserve an otherwise exact duplicate, while Section, Sheet and Paragraph differences do.
The change reduces model context only after retrieval and does not reduce parser, OCR or FTS indexing work.
